It is the thirteenth map that was added to the game. ==Description== In the Gulf of Finland, trapped within the blockade surrounding Tarkov, lies the nuclear-powered icebreaker "Boreas", owned by the logistics corporation Paradigm Shipping. The exact purpose of "Boreas" and the cargo it carries remain unknown. It appears that Paradigm Shipping and TerraGroup made special efforts to minimize any mention of the icebreaker in the press and keep its routes and assignments classified. ==Notes== * This location can initially only be entered through [[Transits|transiting]] from [[Lighthouse]] or [[Shoreline]] after unlocking it in the story chapter [[Boreas]]. The transits are located at the piers and require a [[Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit]].

    • ==Trivia== * This location is based on the Russian "Арктика" (Arktika) nuclear-powered icebreaker. * Initially, the icebreaker was called "Северный ветер" (North Wind) in concept art. In subsequent screenshots, the landing pad read "Сибирь" (Siberia). In the final trailer, the name was changed to "Борей" (Boreas). In ancient Greek mythology, Boreas is the personification of the stormy northern wind. Boreas was also considered the god of winter, descending from the cold mountains of Thrace, cooling the air with his icy breath.
